name: Env_StepFar

name: Evt_Op24

name: Evt_Op25
notes: Op 0x25: Env_InterpChannel(1) [agent:lighting]

name: Evt_Op23

name: Env_SetIntensity

name: Fog_SetRangeEnv

notes: 0x004ABDF0(near / far) [agent:lighting]

name: Env_LightAngleTask

name: Env_InitBlock
notes: Angles 0, dir (0,0,1), +0x38 = 1, fog colour 0, near 65535, far 65536, colour 1, intensity 0.7 (captured at every stage start); called twice by Cam_ResetContexts 0x004021D0 [agent:lighting]

name: Light_SetCustom
signature: void __cdecl (float intensity, int pitch, int yaw, float r, float g, float b)
notes: Light globals from explicit values (direction via 0x0040E0B0); callers 0x00428F70 / 0x0042BC10 / 0x0042BF30 / 0x0042C5A0 / 0x0042D930 / 0x00497F80 .. [agent:lighting]

name: Mdl_EnvMapUV
notes: Rewrites uv of the inline vertices of strips with ctrl 0x100 from the normals and the matrix-stack top: u = (1 - n.col0) * 0.5, v = (n.col1 + 1) * 0.5 [agent:lighting]

name: Mdl_SubmitAlt
notes: Submit record with key 0x04000000 (light table 0x004AA8B0) and the current light globals; reached by Mdl_SelectAlt 0x004185E0 [agent:lighting]

name: Light_InitTable
notes: 16 table lights = directional white (0,0,1), set and disabled on the device (init 0x00418150) [agent:lighting]

name: Light_SetTableMode
notes: Multi-light flag 0x007E813C (Cam_BuildViews sets 1 every frame) [agent:lighting]

name: Light_EnableSlot
notes: 0x007E8128[index] [agent:lighting]

name: Light_SetTableAmbient
notes: AMBIENT 0x007E8138 = trunc(255 * v[1..3]) (0x0057A28C = 0.5 at init, 0x009C71D0 from the table task) [agent:lighting]

name: Light_SetTableLight
notes: Copies the light, position / direction to view space with 0x007E7A68 [agent:lighting]

name: Light_CopyView
notes: View matrix copies 0x007E7A68 / 0x007E7A28 (+ inverse) for the table lights [agent:lighting]

name: Light_ResetTable
notes: Table copies reset, all 16 lights disabled (every frame by 0x00480970) [agent:lighting]

name: Light_TableTask
notes: Reset, then with 0x009A2BB4: flashlights 0x00480AC0, ambient 0x009C71D0, enabled slots of 0x009A1A20 (stride 0x74, +0x68 on, +0x70 index); port World::Impl::TaskLightTable [agent:lighting]

name: Light_StartTableTask
notes: Creates 0x00480970; 0x009A2BB4 = 0x009C8D4C = 0, 0x009C71D0 = 0, ambient 0.5, slots cleared (Stage_Task) [agent:lighting]

name: Light_Flashlights
notes: 0x009C8D4C == 1: slots 1 / 2 = white spot from the camera through each player's aim (state 5 or demo, gun valid), att0 0.5, theta = phi = 0.3927, range sqrt(FLT_MAX) [agent:lighting]

name: Tex_CreateSurfaceNoMip
notes: Clears DDSCAPS_MIPMAP / COMPLEX and DDSD_MIPMAPCOUNT, CreateSurface: textures have no mip levels [agent:lighting]
